sourceInspection.BloodChemistryModel.cpp:231-246: HemoglobinContent sums vascular Hb-species masses after conversion to unbound-Hb equivalent; no concentration/volume substitution in the exported mass.
sourceInspection.Saturation.cpp:737-902: Blood-gas redistribution includes approximate balance corrections and thresholds. resultantTotalHgb_mM is computed before later species corrections and reused by its conservation diagnostics. This makes an exact global-invariance assumption unjustified; it does not prove the cause of the measured cumulative drift.

decision: Post-hoc criterion correction: no repeated loss, not symmetric constancy. Same rtol=1e-6 atol=1e-8; original FAIL remains non-gating. This is not a conservation test; the positive drift cause is unresolved.
unresolved: Exact cumulative source of the small positive Hb-mass drift has not been instrumentally isolated. No red-cell-production, proven floating-point-cause or validated conservation claim.
